The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas in the statistics section, resulting in #NAME? errors.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 returned '#NAME?' instead of the expected numerical statistics (e.g., H46 expected -2.7657, got #NAME?). This error typically indicates a typo in a formula name, a missing named range, or an unsupported Excel function in the generated worksheet.
